name: Access Request Cancelled
description: Sent to users when a pending access request is canceled before it has been approved and provisioned.
subject: #if($emailRecipientName == $requesterName)Your access request#{else}An access request concerning you#end has been cancelled
body:
Access request cancelled

Hello $emailRecipientName,

#if($emailRecipientName == $requesterName)Your pending access request#{else}The pending access request#end#if($isRobo) for #if($emailRecipientName == $requestedForName)you#{else}${requestedForName}#end#end for the following item(s) has been cancelled#if($cancelerName != $emailRecipientName) by ${cancelerName}#end.

#foreach ( $type in ${requestedObjectDetailsByType.keySet()} )

$type :

    #foreach ( $detail in ${requestedObjectDetailsByType.get($type)} )
  • ${detail.name} #if($detail.startDate) (Start date: ${detail.startDate}) #end#if($detail.removeDate) (End date: ${detail.removeDate}) #end
    • #end
#end#if($cancelComment)

#if($emailRecipientName == $cancelerName)You provided the following reason#{else}${cancelerName} provided the following reason#end :
"$cancelComment"

#end#if($emailRecipientName != $cancelerName)

Please contact ${cancelerName} if you have any questions.

#end

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
